answer: In PoA, each identity commits bonded collateral to an escrow and signs messages against a beacon. If k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake, including asymmetric depreciation. Thus a sybil swarm, whether named sparrow or cedar, becomes economically prohibitive: adding agents increases exposure faster than voting power.
